title: Microsoft Copilot Dashboard: intelligent summaries of Copilot adoption trends
summary: Hold: the briefing incorrectly says the web app switch is the only documented control covering the Copilot Dashboard; Microsoft also documents auto-enablement and other access controls. Its claim that Learn mentions intelligent summaries only in a feature table is also inaccurate. The rollout, default state and licence thresholds are supported.

claims.claim: The only documented control that covers the Copilot Dashboard is the Viva Insights web app switch.
claims.quote: This feature access control allows AI Administrators to enable or disable the auto-enablement feature for the Viva Insights web app in their tenant.
claims.fix: Replace 'The only documented control that covers the Copilot Dashboard is the Viva Insights web app switch, which turns off the whole app' with 'The documented Viva Insights web app switch turns off the whole app, including the Copilot Dashboard.' The same cited page also documents individual/group access, auto-enablement, minimum group size and exclusion controls, so do not claim exclusivity.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 admin center > Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy leads to the feature access policy creation page.

From the Microsoft 365 admin center, select **Viva** from the settings menu.
2. Select the **Settings** tab and select **Manage feature access**.
3. Select **Create a policy**.
claims.fix: Complete the path as 'Settings > Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy > Access setting > On or Off'. Keep the note instructing the reader to choose the Viva Insights web app as the feature. The cited page documents selecting the app and feature, then Access setting and On or Off.
